text:
Stradal Group has acquired Fennimore Optics in an all-cash deal valued at 412 million credits, the companies announced on 14 March 2031.

Helena Vörsch, Chief Executive of Stradal Group, confirmed the purchase.

The report rests on the joint merger filing lodged with the Calderon Basin Trade Registry, which sets out the terms of the transaction.

Key points:

- Buyer: Stradal Group
- Target: Fennimore Optics
- Price: 412 million credits, all cash
- Announced: 14 March 2031

The all-cash structure means no share issue and no deferred consideration, so Stradal carries the full cost up front.

What it means for the sector: the deal adds a specialist optics business to a larger group and signals continued consolidation among smaller makers. Rivals of Fennimore Optics will be watching how Stradal folds the business into its operations, and whether further buyers follow.
